title: phaseolus vulgaris var. curdicus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. curdicus, commonly known as garden bean, is a variety of the common bean plant. This plant has been used for its nutritional and medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving blood sugar control, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. curdicus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
